description: This is a Java interface defining the CountryService with methods for retrieving and managing country data.

classes.name: CountryService
classes.description: A service interface for country-related operations, extending generic entity service.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a country entity by its code.

methods.name: addCountryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a specific country.

methods.name: getCountries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries filtered by language.

methods.name: getCountriesMap
methods.description: Retrieves a map of country codes to country entities for a specified language.

methods.name: getCountries (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries filtered by a list of ISO codes and language.
